verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents its own programmatic control surfaces: Shortcuts actions for automation and an x-callback-url scheme, plus a built-in WebDAV server for moving files in and out. These are on-device app automation interfaces rather than a general public API, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: a documented REST/HTTP API with a reference (OpenAPI or similar), detailed evidence of what the x-callback-url and Shortcuts actions expose (e.g. commit/push/pull), and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use.
